section_flow.notes: Full-screen black overlay with hidden video and SKIP button at bottom right; viewport-responsive source switching.
Glassmorphism header with pill-shaped nav links highlighted in red-tinted bg; bold SIGN UP CTA at the right; animated 3-bar hamburger on mobile.

Autoplay-loop muted hero video with double-gradient masking; tracked eyebrow pill (animated dot + EST. 2021 — NRA CERTIFIED), giant 4-line Outfit black headline with middle line in gold-gradient text fill, all-caps Outfit tagline, dual CTAs.
Training Gallery with prev/next arrow buttons, slide-counter badge, dot indicators below; rounded-2xl frame with dark gradient overlay.
500+ students / 12+ courses / 3+ years / 100% NRA in giant Outfit-black numerals — counts up on scroll into view.
4:5 instructor portrait with gradient bottom mask; floating glassmorphism credentials card overlaps the corner with red-pulse dot + bulleted list.
Dotted-radial pattern background with logo at top, accent eyebrow, oversized quote SVG mark behind a blockquote, gradient hairline divider, narrative paragraph.
Legal news context column with external links beside a gold-tinted callout card with circular badge icon + CTA.
Glass card with shield icon + heading + paragraph + email CTA, on red shimmer-animated background gradient.
NRA + Non-NRA class card grids with a 4px left bar that turns red/gold on hover; featured cards get a gold gradient + amber bar.
Brand + quick links + contact + social icon grid; Outfit headings with letter-spacing 0.15em; bottom credits with terms link.

hero_signature: Full-bleed looping range video under two stacked gradients (black -> background bottom, black sides). Eyebrow pill has a live red pulse dot. The h1 is four lines of Outfit Black, middle line rendered with text-gold-gradient (5-stop linear from dark amber through bright gold). The tagline is all-caps DM Sans with 0.12em tracking. Dual CTAs are pill-buttons with scale-1.02 hover.
notable_features: Page-router single-file SPA with multiple hidden views (home, classes, schedule, range, gallery, contact, terms)
Gold-gradient text-fill on h1 fragment using -webkit-background-clip:text and 5 color stops
Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur(16px) and translucent dark fill
Animated red-tinted shimmer band sweeping across CTA sections
Class cards with 4px left accent bar that widens to 5px and changes color on hover
Featured class card variant with subtle amber gradient + amber bar (vs default gray)
Floating credentials card with pulsing red status dot
Animated stat counters that count up via IntersectionObserver
Dotted radial-gradient overlay pattern on mission section
motion_vocabulary: reveal-item with data-anim (fade-up / fade-left / fade-right / scale) and data-delay attributes driven by IntersectionObserver
Hero stagger uses CSS keyframes (fadeInUp / fadeInLeft / fadeInRight / scaleIn) at 0.8s ease-out
Shimmer keyframe sweeps a red 8%-tinted gradient at 3s linear infinite
Subtle gold glow box-shadow on credential card
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .glass + .glass-light (backdrop-blur with translucent dark fill and faint border), .text-gold-gradient (5-stop background-clip text fill), .tactical-line::before (3px x 60px horizontal gradient accent rule), .class-card with __bar + featured modifier (left accent bar that widens on hover), .animate-shimmer + .animate-subtle-glow + .animate-page-fade utility classes. Custom scrollbar with red thumb hover.
